profile_sources.label: Reported Bersatu affiliation · 29 Oct 2026 CSA signatories

profiles.affiliation_note: Bersatu is not attached to PN in the existing party hierarchy. The 29 October CSA report explicitly says the party remains in opposition; budget cooperation is not treated as joining government.

milestones.title: Provide intensive Jawi-writing courses for teachers in Jerai
milestones.description: Sabri described Saturday training courses at his parliamentary service centre.
milestones.progress_note: Two intake series were reported completed, with a third planned. This is an August 2024 activity snapshot; later continuation and a total-course target were not established. No percentage is inferred.

milestones.title: Continue directing part of the MP’s allowance to constituency welfare
milestones.description: Sabri said he allocated about 30% of his monthly allowance to residents in need and would continue during his second term.
milestones.progress_note: The interview is a self-described ongoing practice, not an audited expenditure account. The 30% is a share of allowance, not a completion score; verified spending totals and full-term fulfilment remain unavailable.

milestones.title: Support Budget 2027 under the CSA
milestones.description: The MP was a named agreement signatory.
milestones.progress_note: Signing is documented; subsequent budget votes were not verified. Outcome and completion remain unknown.

methodology: Editorial records of dated public commitments, documented activities and delivery reports. Evidence-only activities and deliveries have no invented earlier promise URL or promise date. Status and numerical progress refer to the dated evidence, not a live performance rating. Joint government, constituency, party and agency roles are identified. Unknown outcomes remain NULL. Additional research may extend the initial pass.
